Startup Portugal brings the public and private sectors together around one goal: making it simpler to start, grow and invest in a company in Portugal.
About us Why Portugal?

PROGRAMS Ecosystem Above & Beyond Hangouts Organized by Startup Portugal every last Wednesday of the month, at Ferroviário (Lisbon), Edifício Transparente (Porto) and online (via Zoom), this Hangout for the entrepreneurial community aims to bring together all the players in the ecosystem to discuss the challenges facing the community.
Ecosystem Road 2 Web Summit R2WS is a program designed in collaboration with Web Summit to promote and support startups based in Portugal in their participation in the technology event.

Internationalization Business Abroad The Business Abroad program ensures and supports the presence of Portuguese startups at international technology conferences, thus creating a more significant impact on their representation outside of Portugal and allowing them to coordinate their communications with international ecosystems and local media.

Ecosystem Tech Foundry Portugal – Deep Tech Edition Tech Foundry Portugal – Deep Tech Edition is a national program designed to help scientific and technological teams move from the laboratory phase to market validation.
It offers four months of intensive acceleration and access to a global network of investors and deep tech experts.

For 10 years, we’ve connected founders, investors, incubators and policymakers.
We are Portugal’s national reference for entrepreneurship.
Since 2016, we’ve bridged the public and private sectors, connecting founders, investors, incubators, companies and policymakers to build a stronger, more cohesive and more international ecosystem.
What we do We support the Government in shaping and implementing public policy for entrepreneurship, and we promote Portuguese startups in Portugal and abroad.

Our work is organised around three pillars: Ignite : we support those taking their first steps, through programs such as Start from Knowledge, Empreende XXI and Tech Foundry Portugal, and through the National Incubator Network (RNi).
Support : we manage Startup and Scaleup status recognition, the One Stop Shop, and support instruments such as the StartUP Vouchers and the Incubator Vouchers.
We work alongside the Ministry of Economy, IAPMEI, ANI, AICEP, Portugal Ventures and Banco Português de Fomento.
We are a founding member of ESNA (European Startup Nations Alliance) and Startups for Europe.
Startup Portugal is a public-interest organisation, funded through a programme contract with IAPMEI, European funds such as the PRR, and its own revenue, including sponsorships.

Our Associates Institute for Support to Small and Medium Enterprises and Innovation IAPMEI (Institute for Support to Small and Medium Enterprises and Innovation) is a public strategic partner supporting micro, small and medium-sized enterprises in the industrial, commercial, service and construction sectors.

Portugal Ventures Created in June 2012, Portugal Ventures plays an active and fundamental role in financing and growing the national entrepreneurship ecosystem, supporting national projects and propelling their sustainable development.

A., aims to develop actions designed to support technological and business innovation in Portugal, contributing to the consolidation of the National Innovation System (SNI) and to strengthening the competitiveness of the national economy in global markets.

Memoranda of Understanding About About us Our Team Strategic Council Reports & Accounts and Legal Information Media Kit Programs Ecosystem Entrepreneurs Start from Knowledge Programs About the program The Start from Knowledge program supports students, researchers, and faculty who want to bring scientific and technological knowledge from academia to the market.
The program awards a non-refundable voucher of €30,000 per project, paid 100% upfront after approval, to support the initial steps in creating and validating the business.

Notice NOTICE Startup Portugal/FITEC-2026-01 Info About the program The Start from Knowledge program is part of Deep2Start, a measure of the Accelerate Economy Plan, and is one of the three project types of the Startup Competitiveness Incentive System.
The program is aimed at micro, small and medium-sized enterprises, including startups.

The company must be majority-owned by an individual who is currently, or has been in the previous two calendar years: Enrolled in a degree-granting study program at a national Higher Education Institution; Or to perform research or teaching duties at a national Higher Education Institution.
Following submission, ANI and Startup Portugal participate in the technical analysis of the applications.
Read the Notice here: CALL Startup Portugal/FITEC-2026-01 .

About the program Operated through IAPMEI, the Startup Visa is a residency visa for entrepreneurs, aimed at attracting investment, talent, and innovation capacity to Portugal.

This is intended for foreign entrepreneurs, without permanent residence in the Schengen Area, who wish to develop their project in Portugal, even if they have not yet established a company, or entrepreneurs who already have business projects in their countries of origin and wish to carry out their activity in Portugal.

The assessment of economic and innovative potential is based on the degree of innovation, the scalability of the business, the market potential, the capacity of the management team, and the potential for creating qualified jobs in Portugal.
